category_title: Students with physical disabilities experiencing fatigue during fine motor tasks
minimal_context: Harry is expected to complete a coloring and writing activity during work time.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Harry, it is work time. Please begin the coloring and writing task.

STUDENT: I am too fatigued to do any more coloring right now.

TUTOR: You just need to keep working on it until it is finished.

STUDENT: I am not going to do the task.

TUTOR: If you refuse, you lose our support and help.

STUDENT: (Starts crying) I am going to do it.

options.A: Provide simultaneous stimulation of nonverbal communication from the perspective of total communication during the coloring and writing activity.
options.B: Provide worksheets with dotted letters on them for the student during the coloring and writing activity.
options.C: Compromise, negotiate situations, and share decisions and power with the student during the coloring and writing activity.
options.D: Implement a program to encourage 'tootling' by providing a collective reward for reaching a target number of prosocial behaviors.
